To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The capacity based adaptation strategy is more susceptible to artifacts such as pixelations and stutters, and is perceived to have a lower level of video quality and clarity than the buffer based strategy; (2) The capacity based strategy is perceived to have higher level of viewer frustration than buffer based strategy; and (3) The buffer based strategy has lower level of viewer frustration, and is perceived as a better video quality experience than the capacity based strategy.
